title: Colours, Shapes and Signs
_source: English for Today, Class Two (NCTB). Unit 7, book pages 63-74.
_note: Colour sentences, both rhymes, the size words and the road-sign names are transcribed from the textbook. Bangla meanings are Pickixo's addition - the book carries no glosses. Drawing, project and word-match activities are pen-and-paper and are offered as 'listen and do' steps where they make sense.
